title: Send Make order handoffs into GoHighLevel
systemName: Your Make to GoHighLevel order handoff

facts: Invented test fixture. Not a saved Upwork job.
Invented brief: Send Make order handoffs into GoHighLevel. Native HTTP Request creates or updates the GHL contact and records the handoff tag; an agreed GHL workflow sends the confirmation.
